expected_facts: Atlas canary is 5%, then 25%, then full pilot traffic.

files.author: Priya Raman
expected_facts: Beacon target is error at most 12%; measured sample error 11.4%; baseline 16%.

files.title: Beacon Route — signed pilot commercial decision
files.author: Emma Laurent
expected_facts: Signed pilot price USD 48,000 for two depots supersedes unsigned USD 62,000 estimate.
Approved error thresholds 12 percent versus 10 percent conflict; Priya Raman must reconcile.
